The remainder of the episodic play traces Yank’s vain attempts to belong somewhere in a New York City that coldly rejects his clumsy advances.
This production benefits from a gritty, red-blooded performance by Beavers, who captures Yank's brutishness but also his resentment at being seen as just a brute.

cn.t: Jon Beavers delivers a strong performance in this timely revival of O'Neill's expressionist class drama, though critics split on whether the century-old play transcends its two-note protagonist.
